scenes.title: A heat pump moves existing heat
The indoor coil heats your rooms
The refrigerant resets for another cycle

vo.text: A heat pump warms your home by moving heat from outdoor air, even when that air feels cold.
vo.speak: A heat pump warms your home by moving heat from outdoor air, even when that air feels cold.

vo.text: It transports existing heat rather than creating heat from nothing.
vo.speak: It transports existing heat rather than creating heat from nothing.

vo.text: Outside, cold refrigerant absorbs heat from the air and evaporates into a gas.
vo.speak: Outside, cold refrigerant absorbs heat from the air and evaporates into a gas.

vo.text: The heat pump's compressor squeezes this gas, raising its pressure and temperature.
vo.speak: The heat pump's compressor squeezes this gas, raising its pressure and temperature.

vo.text: The hot gas enters the indoor coil and releases its heat into your home.
vo.speak: The hot gas enters the indoor coil and releases its heat into your home.

vo.text: A fan blows across that coil, carrying the released heat into your rooms.
vo.speak: A fan blows across that coil, carrying the released heat into your rooms.

vo.text: The refrigerant condenses into a liquid as it gives up heat.
vo.speak: The refrigerant condenses into a liquid as it gives up heat.

vo.text: An expansion valve then lowers its pressure, making it cold again for the outdoor coil.
vo.speak: An expansion valve then lowers its pressure, making it cold again for the outdoor coil.

vo.text: This repeating refrigeration cycle is how the heat pump moves heat indoors.
vo.speak: This repeating refrigeration cycle is how the heat pump moves heat indoors.
